svg.aria-label: DROP IN: One loader script adds chat and vision widgets with sign-in to any page. Milestone M2. BUILD: Your own app on the same services: @synthwerk/react, @synthwerk/vue, @synthwerk/tokens. Tokens now, SDK at M5. RUN IT YOURSELF: Local models in development. Vision runs on CPU with ONNX. No paid AI provider
